questions.question: What is the purpose of a topic sentence in a paragraph?
options: To state the main idea of the paragraph
questions.answer: To state the main idea of the paragraph
questions.explanation: A topic sentence presents the main idea that the paragraph will develop.

questions.question: A concluding sentence should introduce new ideas.
questions.explanation: A concluding sentence summarizes the paragraph, not introduces new ideas.

questions.question: A well-organized essay has an introduction, ___, and conclusion.
questions.explanation: An essay consists of introduction, body paragraphs, and conclusion.

questions.question: What are the key features of a good paragraph?
questions.answer: Unity (one main idea), coherence (logical flow), topic sentence, supporting details, concluding sentence.
questions.explanation: Good paragraphs are unified and coherent with clear structure.
